headline: Housing Overview: Self-Construction, Own Financing and Structural Problems Dominate
summary: A 2026 national housing survey (ENVI) found 20.6 million Mexicans aged 15 and over need or plan to buy or build an independent home, with self-construction and self-financing dominant.
why: Housing demand and financing structures in Mexico shape construction activity and mortgage market development, which matter for real estate and lending investors.
original_headline: Panorama de la vivienda: domina autoconstrucción, financiamiento propio y problemas estructurales
